Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: CyberVox wants lower-latency inference for real‑time summarization in the call workflow, predictable cost per 1k tokens, and a path to deploy behind your VPC with SSO. Your top constraints were:

- Sub‑second median latency for 256‑token responses
- Ability to scale to ~40 concurrent sessions during spikes
- SOC2 evidence/retention window questions for legal

As discussed, the best next step is a focused 30‑minute product brief/demo that covers runtime performance, routing/fallback behavior, and the Dedicated/Private deployment options. Proposed agenda (attached as proposed-agenda-30m.md):

1) 5m — quick context and goals
2) 10m — product demo: latency, batching, and cache behavior
3) 10m — deployment options & compliance + Q&A
4) 5m — next steps / POC scope

Can you please confirm: the technical owner for the session (name + email), any additional stakeholders who must attend (infra/security), and whether you need an NDA or compliance packet before the demo?

Please pick one of these windows — all times are PT:
- Option A: Mon 20 Mar, 09:00–09:30 PT
- Option B: Tue 21 Mar, 13:30–14:00 PT
- Option C: Wed 22 Mar, 16:00–16:30 PT

If none work, tell me two 30‑minute windows next week and I’ll coordinate. I attached the short discovery notes we captured and the 30m agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Tech owner for the session will be me (sam.green@cybervox.ai). I’ll also bring our infra lead, Lena Torres, for the deployment/compliance portion.
- No NDA required for a demo; we do want to see SOC2 scope and retention options during the call.
- We’re particularly interested in how prefix caching and batch sizing affect tail latency for 1–2s response targets.
